Renfrew Heights is an MLS® sub-area of Vancouver. Between November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 65 homes sold there: 49 houses and 12 duplexes. 49 houses sold in Renfrew Heights with a median price of $1,670,000 (the middle half sold between $1,505,000 and $1,833,000), taking a median of 16 days to sell at 96.9% of the last list price; 16% sold above list.
Renfrew Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

49 houses sold in Renfrew Heights with a median price of $1,670,000 (the middle half sold between $1,505,000 and $1,833,000), taking a median of 16 days to sell at 96.9% of the last list price; 16% sold above list. They had a median $771 per square foot, a median year built of 1966 and a median lot of 3,960 square feet. 12 duplexes sold in Renfrew Heights with a median price of $1,224,762 (the middle half sold between $1,080,643 and $1,366,250), taking a median of 40 days to sell at 96.0% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $946 per square foot, a median year built of 2026 and a median strata fee of $219 a month.

items.t: "Renfrew Heights" is an MLS sub-area name and is not one of the City's 22 local areas; the City local area expected to contain it is Renfrew-Collingwood, which the Province lists as a community health service area.

Former RS-zoned areas became R1-1 on October 17, 2023, allowing single detached houses with a suite or laneway house, duplexes, character retention, and multiplexes of 3 to 6 strata units or up to 8 rental units.

The Rupert and Renfrew Station Area Plan (approved July 8, 2025) keeps current R1-1 zoning in its "multiplex areas" furthest from the stations, with towers up to 45 storeys near stations and villages up to six storeys.
January 2026 zoning updates for villages at Renfrew and East 22nd, Rupert and East 22nd, and Renfrew and East 1st allow townhouses and low-rise apartments.

blocks.text: Renfrew Heights: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: Renfrew Park Community Centre, 2929 East 22nd Avenue, has a fitness centre and pool.
The Park Board names Renfrew Ravine, Rupert Park, Beaconsfield Park and Slocan Park in the station area plan.
Renfrew Community Elementary, 3315 East 22nd Avenue, K-7, is part of the Windermere Family of Schools; VSB links a catchment locator and gives no boundary.
TransLink lists Renfrew and Rupert stations on the Millennium Line.

blocks.text: Renfrew Heights: risks and rules a buyer should know

items.t: Still Creek flood management and daylighting are part of the station area plan.
A Building By-law Groundwater Protection Area restricts underground structures to protect Still Creek.
Empty Homes Tax: annual declaration; 3% of assessed value for properties deemed or declared empty in the 2025 reference year (page as retrieved Nov 2026).

faq.q: What did homes in Renfrew Heights sell for?
faq.a: 49 houses sold in Renfrew Heights between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,670,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Renfrew Heights?
faq.a: The median was 16 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.9% of the last list price (16% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Renfrew Heights sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 49 houses that sold in Renfrew Heights went for between $1,505,000 and $1,833,000, around a median of $1,670,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Renfrew Heights sell above asking price?
faq.a: 16% of the 49 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.9% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Renfrew Heights?
faq.a: The median year built was 1966 for the 49 houses sold in Renfrew Heights.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Renfrew Heights usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Renfrew Heights had 5 bedrooms, from the 49 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
